truths.truth: A fresh data directory takes a single-file ingest with no error, and search finds turns from that transcript
truths.evidence: Spot-check, isolated env (HOME and TERMINUS_DATA_DIR in the scratchpad, data dir absent beforehand): `terminus ingest` on a copy of a real transcript (e900b339-...jsonl) exited 0 and created the store; `terminus search Running --project /code/baley/crates --json` returned ok with 6 hits, all from that session. The same run on tests/fixtures/session-basic.jsonl found `backwards` in turn 5. Search is scoped to the cwd's project by design, so `--project` names the transcript's cwd.

truths.truth: initialize asking for 2025-03-26 is answered 2025-06-18, and 2025-03-26 is not offered
truths.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/mcp/mod.rs:74 PROTOCOL_VERSIONS is [2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2024-11-05, 2024-10-07]; DEFAULT_PROTOCOL_VERSION 2025-06-18 at :83. Test cmd::mcp::tests::the_revision_that_requires_batches_is_not_offered (mod.rs:264) passed in the suite run. Spot-check: piping initialize with protocolVersion 2025-03-26 into target/debug/terminus mcp printed result.protocolVersion "2025-06-18"; a two-ping batch got one line, code -32600, id null.

truths.truth: A request id that is not a string or an integer in the i64 or u64 range is refused with -32600 and a null id; strings and in-range integers are echoed
truths.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/mcp/rpc.rs:114 accepts only is_string() || is_i64() || is_u64(). Test a_request_id_that_is_not_an_integer_that_fits_is_refused (rpc.rs:221) passed. Spot-check through the binary: ids 1.5, 1.0, 1e3, 18446744073709551616 and -9223372036854775809 each got {"code":-32600,...,"id":null}; 18446744073709551615, -9223372036854775808 and "abc" were answered with the id echoed.

truths.truth: recall_get removes repeated ids before the 25-id cap, keeping first-asked order
truths.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/mcp/tools.rs:535 `asked.retain(|id| seen.insert(*id))` runs before the cap at :541, so `served` and the reason's M count distinct ids. Test repeated_ids_are_removed_before_the_cap (tests/mcp.rs:1044) passed: 30 ids / 20 distinct returns those 20 in asked (reversed) order with null reason; 35 ids / 30 distinct serves the first 25 and the reason reads "only the first 25 of 30 ids".

truths.truth: The projected turn body never exceeds MAX_BODY_BYTES, including when separators push it over, and never ends on a bare newline
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/index/text.rs:103-118 `push` charges the separator (`remaining -= separator + take` at :117), writes it only when take > 0, and sets `full` after a cut; `leaves` stops on `full`. Wired: derive.rs:115 maps every turn through index::project, which calls text::project. Four tests in index::text::tests passed, including a_record_that_fills_the_cap_only_with_separators_stays_under_it (:246). Scope note: MAX_BODY_BYTES bounds the projected text; index::project then appends expansion tokens under their own MAX_EXPANSION_BYTES (index/expand.rs:36), by design and outside #20, as PLAN-2's context states.

truths.truth: A compact_boundary subtype on a user, assistant or attachment record gets no boundary row; a system record still does
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/derive.rs:62 checks row.turn.record_type == "system" with the subtype, and derive.rs:164 is the one site that writes the boundary row; parse/record.rs:112 applies the same rule to Record::is_compact_boundary. Tests passed: a_boundary_subtype_on_a_record_that_is_not_system_gets_no_row (tests/compaction.rs:339), only_a_system_record_is_a_compact_boundary (tests/parse.rs), and the unchanged appending_a_boundary_records_it_and_disturbs_nothing_already_archived and a_rebuild_reproduces_the_boundary_row_from_the_blob_alone.

truths.truth: The miss-labelling query matches recall_search by the extractor's rule and never recall_get, xrecall_search or the uppercase name
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/feedback/label.rs:242-243 `tool_name = 'recall_search' OR tool_name GLOB '*_recall_search'`, the recall_get arm gone; GLOB is case-sensitive with a literal `_`, matching index::entity::is_recall_search (entity.rs:61-66). Both miss() (:199) and sought() (:274) build on sought_sql. Test the_miss_query_matches_recall_search_by_the_extractors_rule (tests/label.rs:615) passed over all five names.

truths.truth: Two opens of a fresh data directory race safely: the losing initialize waits for the write lock instead of failing
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/store/open.rs:304 initialize opens Transaction::new_unchecked(..., TransactionBehavior::Immediate); Store::open calls it for a fresh store at :182, and status opens through Store::open (cmd/status.rs:40). Test store::open::tests::a_losing_initialize_waits_for_the_write_lock (open.rs:951) passed in the suite run. The revert half was not re-run in Rust (it would mean editing the source); a scratch Python sqlite3 probe (SQLite 3.54.0) of the same sequence observed it: BEGIN DEFERRED + CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + INSERT failed with "database is locked" at 0.00s despite a 5 s busy timeout, while BEGIN IMMEDIATE waited and succeeded at 1.03 s, matching reports/plan-3.md.

truths.truth: A single-file ingest records 1 walked and 1 committed in its runs row, and status shows it
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/mod.rs:1267 inserts files_seen 1, files_committed 1, files_failed 0; record_run is called at :547. Test status_counts_the_file_a_single_file_ingest_committed (tests/status.rs:191) passed. Spot-check: after `terminus ingest <path>` on a fresh scratch store, `terminus status` printed `files        1 walked, 1 committed, 0 failed`.

truths.truth: reindex reports its preserved count in JSON (success and lock-held), in docs, and on stderr only when above 0
truths.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/reindex.rs:46 adds preserved 0 to the lock-held document, :73 adds rebuilt.preserved to the success document, :92-97 prints the stderr line only when preserved > 0. docs/json-shapes.md:217 example and bullet; docs/commands.md:116 says it is printed; DATA_COMMANDS lists it (tests/cli.rs:1006). Tests reindex_json_reports_a_held_lock_as_a_document and reindex_reports_the_evicted_sessions_it_carried_across passed. Spot-check: on an unevicted scratch store plain reindex printed only `rebuilt 8 turn(s) across 1 session(s)` and --json carried "preserved":0; with the session marked evicted, plain printed `preserved 1 evicted session(s) without rebuilding them` and --json carried "preserved":1.

truths.truth: verify fails an evicted session that still has block rows, once, naming that session
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/verify.rs:161-178 counts the evicted session's block rows and pushes one Failure with block None when the count is above 0. Test an_evicted_session_that_still_has_block_rows_is_one_failure (tests/verify.rs:443) passed, as did the three unchanged evicted tests. Spot-check: with is_evicted set and its 1 block row left, `terminus verify` printed one failure naming that session ("evicted, but 1 block row(s) remain"), `1 session(s) checked, 1 failed`, exit 1; --json showed block null.

truths.truth: brief.rs defines no chars or clip of its own and calls the shared ones
truths.evidence: grep of crates/terminus-core/src/inject/brief.rs finds no `fn chars` or `fn clip`; line 60 imports `super::{chars, clip, Payload}` and the call sites at :212, :225, :234, :341, :362 use them. The shared pair in inject/mod.rs:191-212 has the same body as the deleted one, so the brief is unchanged; the inject_brief, inject_compaction, inject_prompt, brief and inject tests passed in the suite run.

truths.truth: No test name claims a process death when none happens; the renamed lock test points to the crash harness
truths.evidence: grep -rn the_lock_is_released_by_process_death over crates, docs and CHANGELOG.md finds nothing. crates/terminus/tests/lock_race.rs:118 is a_held_lock_refuses_a_second_attempt_and_frees_when_dropped, and its comment names killing_ingest_anywhere_leaves_a_store_that_converges at :115; both passed. Other test names claiming a kill (crash.rs, hook.rs:689, backfill.rs:431) do kill processes (sigkill / kill_and_reap); a_pass_that_dies_mid_walk_still_leaves_its_runs_row names a failed pass, not a killed process, and keeps its name per D-13.

truths.truth: json-shapes.md says when each D-14 sessions and show field is null
truths.evidence: docs/json-shapes.md:114-147 (show: tool_name, ts, project, body, context, and inside context turns[].tool_name, turns[].ts, continues_from, reason) and :160-174 (sessions: project, project_pre_worktree, branch, first_turn_at, last_turn_at, watermark), 15 fields in all. Spot-checked against code: tool_name is the first tool_use block's name (parse/record.rs:399-408); a missing session_meta row is a verify failure (verify.rs check, "no session_meta row"); eviction keeps the watermark row (retention/apply.rs evict_one deletes only blocks; delete_one is the path that drops watermarks).

One run of `cargo test --workspace --all-features --offline` at HEAD 039ab06 (code identical to 94e34d7): exit 0, 66 test binaries, 877 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; log in the session scratchpad suite.log.
